Title: Public Preview: Observability developer experience in Azure Developer CLI (azd)

Body.Content:
Use the Azure Developer CLI (azd) CLI evaluation experience to add a measured quality loop to an agent created with Microsoft Foundry. It empowers users on the hosted-agent lifecycle in azd, where you create, provision, deploy, initialize evaluation assets, run a first evaluation, inspect the run, and reuse the evaluation recipe for later runs. 

Learn more.
